findings.message: The default launch speed in the captures is 5 m/s, but the layout says the default scrubber reads 0 to 1.020408 s. That range belongs to a launch speed of 10 m/s. A 5 m/s launch should read 0 to 1.020408 s for the full flight (2v/g = 1.0204), so the end capture is consistent. But the layout's "default inputs" statement is ambiguous. Launch speeds 3 and 10 give 0.612 s and 2.041 s, which matches full flight time. The cp-fastTop capture at t=1.020408 with speed 10 is the apex, which is also consistent. So the scrubber ranges look correct. I can't confirm the default input is 5 from the layout.

The Motion arrow is absent at the top, as the plan requires. But the plan's observation says the motion arrow readout is shown by the motionState readout. The frames show no text drawn for the callout contents (callout.toss.l0 and l1 are only boxes with no text). So "names the motion and shows gravity" can't be verified from the frame.

At t = 1.020408 s with launch speed 5, the ball is back at the start with v = -5, and the frame shows a downward arrow of length 60. The state label says "Back at start", which is acceptable. However, the same capture time as cp-fastTop makes the fastTop observation depend on the input change. The scale check looks right: 5 m/s gives apex 1.2755 m = 42.5 px (about 33.3 px/m), and 10 m/s gives 5.102 m = 170 px. Both match the fixed scale. The frames show a constant gravity arrow of length 48 in all captures.
